data.body: OUTCOME & RESIDUALS: Epic COMPLETE. Full test suite consolidated onto Ubuntu for the gate; reduced compatibility sweep moved to scheduled CI against origin/main (runs periodically, not on every Gerrit change), preserving unit coverage on cheap fixtures inside the Verified Gate. CodeQL owner-decision comment posted on epic: keep scheduled/non-gating. (E) still deferred — reassess only if a residual long pole appears after these changes bed in. No further Gerrit/ticket/code actions pending. Both feature worktrees removed; all /tmp experiment artifacts and locked-dep venvs cleaned up.
